name: bari-nextjs
title: BARI — shadcn/ui Dashboard (dark rail, light canvas)
description: Dashboard Next.js App Router berbasis shadcn/ui: sidebar collapsible-icon yang SELALU gelap (dark rail) di atas kanvas terang/gelap, header sticky blur dengan breadcrumb + theme toggle, dan halaman login (kredensial + opsi SSO). Modern, aksesibel, cocok untuk panel admin React/Next.
origin_stack: Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui

style.vibe: clean shadcn, dark-rail sidebar, aksen cyan, garis cahaya 'shell-sweep'

colors.sidebar: oklch(0.17 0.018 255) /* navy gelap, TIDAK ikut light mode */

style.dark_mode: next-themes (light/dark/system) via ThemeToggle; sidebar tetap gelap di kedua mode

prereq: Butuh komponen shadcn: sidebar, button, input, separator, dropdown-menu, tooltip, breadcrumb, field. Pasang: `npx shadcn@latest add sidebar button input separator dropdown-menu tooltip breadcrumb`. Plus `npm i next-themes lucide-react`.

files.role: Token oklch (:root/.dark) + token sidebar dark-rail + @keyframes & .shell-sweep + gaya menu aktif
Shell panel: SidebarProvider > AppSidebar + SidebarInset(PanelHeader + children)
Sidebar shadcn collapsible=icon: brand + NavMain(dari config) + NavUser + Rail
Header sticky blur: SidebarTrigger + breadcrumb + ThemeToggle
Form login: username/password (show-hide) + CTA gradien + tombol SSO

adapt.next: Pakai langsung (App Router). Ganti brand, NAV items, dan endpoint auth.
adapt.react: Tanpa Next: ganti next/link-><a>, usePathname->router lib (react-router), next-themes tetap bisa atau pakai class toggler sendiri. Struktur shadcn sama.
adapt.vue: Port ke shadcn-vue: komponen setara (Sidebar, Button, Input). Token oklch & .shell-sweep terbawa. State via ref.
adapt.blade: Kurang cocok — untuk Laravel/Blade gunakan template 'simobe-lpm'.

conventions.table: @tanstack/react-table — https://tanstack.com/table (headless; render sendiri dengan komponen shadcn Table)
conventions.select: react-select — https://react-select.com (searchable/multi). Di project shadcn boleh pakai Combobox (Popover+cmdk) sebagai alternatif native.
conventions.icons: react-icons — https://react-icons.github.io/react-icons/ (import { FaUser } from 'react-icons/fa', dst). lucide-react tetap boleh untuk ikon UI shadcn.
conventions.note: Stack JS/React: tabel headless TanStack + komponen sel sendiri; dropdown react-select; ikon react-icons.
